notes.title: Patch 1.4.10
notes.content:
[p]We notice all your feedbacks since launch and fix a lot of issues with this patch : [/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Interfaces[/b][/p][list][*][p]Domain day and time added to pause menu (only displayed when player is in the Domain)[/p][/*][*][p]Visual improvement of the naturon counter in the top right-hand corner of the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Blue indoor/outdoor arrows are now hidden during cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]White interaction circles appear earlier when approaching interactable elements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed scrolling in several menus[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected game time displayed on a save slot when a new game is started[/p][/*][*][p]Added a distinctive sign in the name of NPCs linked to patrons to better identify them and make it easier to obtain the “Thank you for the support!” achievement.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected character level display when max game level is reached[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed joystick icons in game control settings[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Puzzles[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug in the Academy puzzle that prevented cars from being chronopacked in some cases[/p][/*][*][p]Chronopacking a tree when being too close could block the player[/p][/*][*][p]Simplification of the first puzzle on the athletics track[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Various issues[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved transitions at the end of cutscenes when they are skipped[/p][/*][*][p]Added an “Inventory full” message when retrieving an item if the maximum number has already been reached[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented enemies from reappearing when reloading a level under certain conditions[/p][/*][*][p]In the Domain, characters are now healed during the night[/p][/*][*][p]Scythe tool cutting speed increased[/p][/*][*][p]Various bug fixes and improvements in combat[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Thanks for playing our game, we hope you’ll enjoy it and stay tuned for further patches![/p]

tags.feature: Domain day and time added to pause menu (only displayed when player is in the Domain)
Visual improvement of the naturon counter in the top right-hand corner of the screen.
Blue indoor/outdoor arrows are now hidden during cutscenes
White interaction circles appear earlier when approaching interactable elements

tags.bug: Fixed scrolling in several menus
Corrected game time displayed on a save slot when a new game is started

tags.feature: Added a distinctive sign in the name of NPCs linked to patrons to better identify them and make it easier to obtain the “Thank you for the support!” achievement.

tags.bug: Corrected character level display when max game level is reached
Fixed joystick icons in game control settings
Fixed a bug in the Academy puzzle that prevented cars from being chronopacked in some cases
Chronopacking a tree when being too close could block the player

tags.feature: Simplification of the first puzzle on the athletics track
Improved transitions at the end of cutscenes when they are skipped
Added an “Inventory full” message when retrieving an item if the maximum number has already been reached

tags.bug: Fixed a bug that prevented enemies from reappearing when reloading a level under certain conditions

tags.feature: In the Domain, characters are now healed during the night

tags.bug: Various bug fixes and improvements in combat
Various minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.3.13
notes.content:
We notice all your feedbacks since launch and fix a lot of issues with this patch : 

[h1][b]Battles[/b][/h1]
Fixing issue with a freeze during the Frost Golem Fight.
Fixing issue with a freeze during the Twin Golem Fight.
Fixing issue with the MRI fight that let the chrono points gauge locked during battles.
Fixing an issue with the UI on the temporal mist attack.
Fixing white screen issue when launching some fights.
Fixing UI issues when you flee a battle.
Fixing issue when you flee a battle with one character dead.
Fixing issue that let an enemy still visible after his death in battle.
Fixing issue with temporal Aura.
Fixing issues with Toxin and Regeneration that lead to having characters alive with 0 hp or dead with few hp, and the inability to revive the character.
Fixing issue when you start a battle during a dialogue.
Retrying a combat after a gameover will now heal the team.
Minor difficulties adjustment with bosses.
Minor vfx bugs fixes.

[h1][b]Puzzles[/b][/h1]
Fixing UI issue with Fenimale power icon when she join the group.
Fixing puzzles not set correctly at first loading.
Fixing colliding issue with the background that let the characters stuck. 
Fixing Issue with Fenimale power in the Stadium Puzzle.
Fixing issue with the bumper.
Fixing issue with the spikes when a character stay on it.
Fixing issue with frozen characters when changing characters while entering a puzzle portal.

[h1][b]Various issues[/b][/h1]
Fixing clock issue in the Domain which affect the plants growth.
Fixing issues that let the enemies frozen when you encounter them.
Fixing issue with the lighter quest that makes the NPC reappear.
Fixing an issue with Bloom FX.

Thanks for playing our game, we hope you’ll enjoy it and stay tuned for further patches!

notes.title: Maliki: Poison of the Past is now available!
notes.content:
This is it—after [b]more than 20 years of adventures and stories in graphic novels, the candy-pink-haired heroine[/b] created by [b]Souillon[/b] is ready to make her first foray into the world of [b]video games[/b]! Play [b]Maliki: Poison of the Past[/b] now!

[previewyoutube=36OvbkB0Csg;full][/previewyoutube]

Discover [b]a family of characters[/b] with strong and zany identities, at the heart of the franchise's [b]dynamic and zesty universe.[/b] In Maliki: Poison of the Past, embark on an [b]ecological fable[/b] to save the planet and repair spacetime!
 
An [b]all-new combat system,[/b] [b]strategic battles[/b] where you have to manipulate time, all set in [b]a cute and colorful universe[/b] that's perfectly Malikiful—a crazy adventure is about to unfold…
 
[u][b]Enjoy a 10% launch discount through May 6![/b][/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893260/Maliki__Poison_Of_The_Past/

[h3][i]Adventure is calling you, and the Domaine needs you today…[/i][/h3]
